song.title: You're Gonna Be Ok
song.lyrics:
[V1] .Am F C I know it's all you've got to just be strong .Am F C And it's a fight just to keep it together .Am F C I know you think that you are too far gone .Am F But hope is never lost .C Hope is never lost
[P1] . Dm C G Hold on, don't let go . Dm C G Hold on, don't let go
[C1] . F G Am Just take one step closer . C Put one foot in front of the other . F G Am You'll get through this . C F Just follow the light in the darkness . C You're gonna be ok
[V2] .Am F C I know your heart is heavy from those nights .Am F C But just remember that you are a fighter .Am F C You never know just what tomorrow holds .Am And you're stronger than you know .C F You're stronger than you know
[B1] . F C And when the night is closing in . F C Don't give up and don't give in . F C This won't last, it's not the end . F It's not the end . C You're gonna be ok
[B2] . F C And when the night is closing in . F C Don't give up and don't give in . F C This won't last, it's not the end . C It's not the end . C You're gonna be ok
song.author: Brian Johnson & Jenn Johnson, Jenn Johnson
